remarks: Welcome to 50 Autumn Creek Court. Beautifully appointed 2019 Legacy-Built Modern Colonial residence with over 3,200 square feet of luxury open-concept living situated on a private wooded lot and surrounded by limitless amenities. Curb appeal abounds at this meticulous and move-in-ready home featuring professional landscaping and stacked stone and vinyl exterior finishes with craftsman elevations. The bright and expansive main level with soaring ceilings boasts a flexible den space, an inviting formal dining room and an expansive two-story great room with custom built-ins, brand-new luxury carpet and a gas fireplace. Gleaming hardwood flows seamlessly throughout the majority of the first floor. The gourmet quartz eat-in kitchen is an entertainer’s dream boasting a massive butcher block island, an abundance of solid wood cabinetry, stainless appliances and walk-in pantry. Easy access to the backyard through a door off the kitchen. A laundry area, mudroom with more custom built-ins and freshly painted half bath add to the numerous conveniences of this special property. The second floor provides enough room for everyone to relax and unwind. The primary en-suite is an absolute retreat, featuring a spa-like bath with a walk-in shower, soaking tub, an oversized double-sink vanity and a walk-in closet large enough to fit your wardrobe for every season. Two of the generous bedrooms creatively share an adjoining full bath with separate vanities and a tub surround. The fourth bedroom has immediate proximity to a third full bathroom further enhancing functionality. Capital enhancements include an architectural roof, high-efficiency furnace and central air, tankless hot water system and expanded concrete driveway. Additional features include a 2+ car attached garage and full basement ready to be finished. Enjoy the outdoors in the fully fenced backyard. Located in Top Rated Williamsville North Schools (Dodge Road Elementary) and close to parks, schools and all the shopping, restaurants and other conveniences Transit Road has to offer. A rare opportunity to make this truly exceptional property your new home.
